text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Admire Vega and Narita Top Road arrive at 
the venue separately for the first time in 
a while. Though they trade subtle barbs 
before the race, they both seem to be 
enjoying it on some level.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so, right before the Japan Cup began, 
TM Opera O told everyone that this wasn't 
a race where only the winner should shine.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
To shine brightly, just like the "Golden 
Generation"— Each shining in their own 
way, giving it their all. The four made 
that vow in the paddock.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
—With not a single soul missing, the 
miraculous Japan Cup gets underway!
